description: Generate NanoIDs or custom-alphabet random IDs with crypto randomness, plus a collision-probability estimate. Operations: "generate" — Generate one or more random IDs (default: 21-char URL-safe NanoID).; "collision" — Estimate how long until a 1% collision chance for an alphabet size, ID length and rate.. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant). Not repeatable: generate returns a different result on each call.

input.description: generate: A custom alphabet, or empty for the default URL-safe NanoID alphabet. collision: The alphabet (its unique character count is used), or empty for the default.

operation.description: generate — Generate one or more random IDs (default: 21-char URL-safe NanoID). collision — Estimate how long until a 1% collision chance for an alphabet size, ID length and rate.

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

count.description: How many IDs. Used by: generate.

perHour.description: IDs generated per hour. Used by: collision.

size.description: Characters per ID. Used by: generate, collision.

name: nanoid
title: NanoID Generator
